findings.quote: In coordination with TTC, and in preparation for the opening of the Eglinton Crosstown LRT, 21 existing bus stop locations are proposed to be removed and consolidated with nearby existing stops, and four stop locations are proposed to be adjusted.
findings.rule: bus stop locations are proposed to be removed and consolidated

findings.quote: The consolidation of stops is intended to improve travel time for buses that will continue to access the Eglinton corridor as well as overnight service.
